_comment: Commit-C fixture (M39 elevon-tip follow-up). The REAL, measured mesh cross-section of newoutsidewingelevon.stl at layer 1247 (print_z=249.6mm, slice_z=249.5mm, 9.155e-5mm below the mesh's own z_max, sectioned via MeshSectioner after the M39 downward-nudge fix). NOT a synthetic aerofoil: the wing tapers to a near-zero-chord tip, so the true section here is a knife-edge sliver, not a flat cap. Dumped in the CANONICAL post-M38-rotation frame (rotated by -theta, theta=89.98454229210878 deg, the sharp-TE-band-resolved global alignment for this wing) so frame.rotation_deg reads ~0 deg here, matching what StructureGenerator.generate() actually sees during a real run (the raw, un-derotated mesh section is rotated ~90 deg and trips the UNRELATED rotation-envelope check before ever reaching the pitch-collapse/classify_region path this fixture exists to exercise).
